task.description:
Re-point the tests that read Sai instruction files and compare Russian wording to the English wording introduced by run TRANSL-20261025-01 (decisions/0080, item 6). Before this run the full test run had exactly 11 known red tests (HO-46, HO-47, HC-RT-1e, LG-10c, SF-6c, SU-10, SU-11, SV-1f, SV-7e, TR-4b, TR-4e); the translation made about 37 more red. Fix only the extra ones.
Rules: (1) a test is never weakened, deleted, skipped or loosened to a bare "file exists": each re-pointed test must check the same fact (same section present, same rule stated, same number) in the English text, using the section titles and phrases that now exist in the files; (2) if a test fails because a translation lost or changed a fact (a rule, number, section, cross reference or a role-file front matter key), do not change the test — fix the English text in the instruction file and note it in result.issues with the exact place; (3) text of pages, tool messages and quoted Russian terms stay Russian where the files quote them; (4) known reds HO-46, HO-47, HC-RT-1e, LG-10c, SF-6c, SU-10, SU-11, SV-1f, SV-7e, TR-4b, TR-4e are not yours and must stay as they are; (5) cross references in the instruction files that name a section by its old Russian title (for example the section "Команда handoff" of tools/README.md quoted in handoffs.md) must be aligned with the section titles that actually exist, and a test that guards such a reference stays; (6) the failing tests known so far: DC-01, DC-02, FS-16, NM-09, MC-07, ST-06, RD-1…RD-4, TM-01, TM-50, EN-75, TD-1…TD-3, REQ-003, HO-50…HO-52, HC-9a, WEB-12, EX-37 and others you find with the full run. Work on a spare clone of tag base/TRANSL-20261025-01 for comparing old and new wording (a fresh git clone outside the project, never checkout/reset/stash/clean here). Finish with cd tools && npm run check: only the 11 known reds may remain. In result list every re-pointed test with the old and the new fact checked, and every fix of an instruction file.

result.summary: Re-pointed the tests that read Sai instruction files to the English wording of run TRANSL-20261025-01 (decisions/0080 item 6). Before: full run 1898 tests, 48 red (11 known + 37 extra). Now: 1898 tests, 1887 pass, 11 fail - exactly the 11 known (HO-46, HO-47, HC-RT-1e, LG-10c, SF-6c, SU-10, SU-11, SV-1f, SV-7e, TR-4b, TR-4e). 37 tests in 15 files were re-pointed, each to the same fact in the English text; no test was deleted, skipped or loosened. Instruction files fixed where the translation lost a fact: the heading '## Quality bar — binding' in 5 role files (em dash had become a hyphen), the 18-word rule in the README paragraph about forbidden signs (3 sentences), and 6 cross references to sections by old or wrong titles. The old wording was compared with a fresh clone of the tag base/TRANSL-20261025-01 outside the project.

The 37 extra were found with the full run (the list in the task was complete for them: DC-01, DC-02, FS-16, NM-09, MC-07, ST-06, SV-12, RD-1..4 and the blind-rules test, TM-01, TM-50, EN-75, TD-1..TD-3 (6 tests), REQ-003 AC1 and AC2, HO-50..HO-52, HC-9a, WEB-12, EX-33, EX-37 (3), EX-06, CTL-13, CTL-14f, TT-10a, TT-10b).

FS-16 has no English form of those three words: the README names no progress bar words in English that could be tested without guessing, so the Russian forms stay.
